title: NASA Sun fact sheet: absolute magnitude +4.83
summary: The Sun fact sheet lists absolute magnitude as +4.83.
body: NASA's Sun fact sheet lists Absolute magnitude as +4.83 for the Sun. A bulk-parameter cell. Mass, volumetric mean radius, luminosity, spectral type, and the sidereal rotation period are on other cards and are not repeated as the claim here. Last Updated line: 9 May 2024.

sources.title: Sun Fact Sheet
sources.author: Dr. David R. Williams, NASA Goddard Space Flight Center, NSSDCA
